Game Overview

In Collect Three, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a captivating logic puzzle where your goal is to match and merge three identical images. Strategize to maximize your limited space, avoiding blocked moves that lead to defeat. With intuitive touch controls and a collection of levels, it's a delightful brain-teasing challenge for all ages.
